title: Lively East Nashville Pad: Walk to Bars & Eateries
description:
Immerse yourself in The Music City when you book this 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath vacation rental home in Nashville! Whether you want to dive into the music scene in downtown Nashville or chill around the fire pit on a quiet back patio just minutes from downtown, this home in East Nashville is sure to please! The home offers a fully equipped and stocked kitchen and is also just three blocks from Riverside Village where you can choose from eight different eateries and pubs! Treat yourself!

The space
Permit #2020009123 | Long-Term Renters Welcome | Free WiFi

Whether you’re in town for country music, museum tours, or vibrant nightlife, this cozy abode offers all the comforts of home in a convenient location so you can easily explore Nashville’s best attractions.

Bedroom 1: King Bed | Bedroom 2: Full Bed | Bedroom 3: Full Sleeper Sofa | Living Room: Twin Daybed

OUTDOOR LIVING: Fenced yard, furnished patio, fire pit
KITCHEN: Fully equipped, drip coffee maker, coffee starter kit, cooking basics
INDOOR LIVING: Flat-screen TV, electric fireplace, dining table, ceiling fans, bidet
GENERAL: Washer & dryer, towels, linens, iron & board, hair dryer, curling iron & flat iron, central air conditioning/heat, keyless entry
FAQ: Stairs required to access
PARKING: Driveway (4 vehicles)

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire property

Other things to note
- No smoking 
- No pets allowed
- No events, parties or large gatherings
- Additional fees and taxes may apply
- Photo ID may be required upon check-in
- NOTE: Access to the home requires stairs
